'''Pyrefiends''' are [[Slayer]] monsters that require level 30 Slayer to kill. They can drop the rare [[Flameburst defender]], which increases the power of the [[Frostbite dagger]] and the [[Hailstorm dagger]], as well as enable the use of dual wield abilities within Daemonheim. They are found on all [[Dungeoneering floors]].
